author: WhyOS-Apps contributors
description:
A VNC server: a viewer on a computer (macOS's Screen Sharing, TigerVNC,
RealVNC and others) shows the badge's screen and types on its keys. It
is a service, without a tile: turn it on in Settings > Connection > VNC
server, where you also find the addresses to connect to (Wi-Fi, and
192.168.4.1 over the USB cable) and the password, with a button for a
new one. It starts again after a restart.

It needs full access to the badge, as anyone who has the password
controls it. The session is not encrypted: use it on your own network or
the cable. There is no pointer, only the keys.
